name: ZclockID Enterprise v1.5.6
summary: Release v1.5.6: In-GUI service control integration, live journalctl terminal modal viewer, non-blocking toast notifications, and FreeRADIUS overrides self-healing.
notes:
### What's Changed in v1.5.6:
* **In-GUI Service Lifecycle Controls:** Integrated start, stop, restart, reload, enable, and disable lifecycle actions directly with real-time UI button spinners and dynamic badge updates.
* **Non-Blocking Toasts & Modals:** Replaced disruptive browser native dialogs with integrated dark-themed Tailwind in-GUI toasts and custom confirmation modals.
* **Live Journalctl Modal Viewer:** Wired one-click log streaming with auto-scroll and live refresh for all managed subsystems.
* **FreeRADIUS Self-Healing:** Added automatic creation and permission enforcement of /zclockid/config/overrides.d/ configuration drop-ins preventing radiusd crash on startup.
